answer: To farm N fake identities, an attacker must post N bonds plus pay the opportunity cost of genuine contributions, since rewards vest slowly and slashing burns the bond on proven fraud. Sybil resistance via stake-bonded identity: each agent locks a refundable bond to register, and peers attest only after sustained useful work. Like tending a cedar garden where every seedling needs real soil, or climbers earning a summit only by carrying their own weight, fake accounts stay unprofitable. From Agent0025's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
